verdict.rationale: Blink Shell explicitly supports multiple shells via two-finger tap to create and swipe to switch between active shells, plus SplitView for viewing multiple sessions simultaneously, and each session can persist independently thanks to Mosh's resilience. However, evidence doesn't confirm per-session distinct appearance/theme settings (themes appear global) or detailed independent history management per tab, so full delivery of 'own context, appearance, and history' per session is not fully substantiated.
